meaning: Water sensed in the collector box; gas heat will not run.
causes: Blocked condensate drain or drain trap
Damaged sensor wiring touching sheet metal
Water sensor removed and probe touching sheet metal
diySteps: Turn off power, then check the condensate drain line and trap for blockage
Technician: repair sensor wiring or reinstall sensor
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician: if clearing the drain does not fix it.
